title: DNS dashboard consumes DNS Nostr read models directly
observed_behavior: web/src/routes/dns/+page.ts fetched /api/v1/dns/* REST endpoints and web/src/lib/stores/dns.svelte.js exposed REST fetch helpers plus page refresh behavior.
intended_behavior: The DNS dashboard opens a long-lived Nostr relay subscription to Bahia DNS read-model kinds 31975, 31976, 31977, and 31978 scoped to the Bahia service pubkey. EVENT frames update UI state, EOSE marks historical catch-up complete, and CLOSED/AUTH conditions are surfaced without REST refreshes.
